text: 截至目前，ETF两市成交额报7230.99亿元，较昨日此时放量172.31亿元，分类型来看，股票型ETF成交额2494.57亿元，债券型ETF成交额3004.58亿元，货币型ETF成交额511.28亿元，商品型ETF成交额175.26亿元，QDII型ETF成交额1045.31亿元。其中，成交额最高的非货币型ETF分别是科创50ETF（588000）、中韩半导体ETF（513310）、创业板ETF（159915），成交额分别为：189.11亿元、182.56亿元、163.95亿元。
text_en: As of now, total ETF turnover in the two markets stands at RMB 723.099 billion, up RMB 17.231 billion from the same time yesterday. By category, equity ETF turnover is RMB 249.457 billion, bond ETF turnover is RMB 300.458 billion, money market ETF turnover is RMB 51.128 billion, commodity ETF turnover is RMB 17.526 billion, and QDII ETF turnover is RMB 104.531 billion. Among them, the non-money-market ETFs with the highest turnover are STAR 50 ETF (588000), China-Korea Semiconductor ETF (513310) and ChiNext ETF (159915), with turnover of RMB 18.911 billion, RMB 18.256 billion and RMB 16.395 billion, respectively.
